description: A five-panel composite TEM figure (Fig. 6) on the as-cast 6Cr steel strip, mixing bright-field and dark-field micrographs with selected-area diffraction patterns (SADP); the group is temporally/phase-resolved across γ-austenite (a,b) and δ-ferrite (c-e). (a) is a bright-field (BF) image of γ-austenite — a featureless dark band/interface region marked with a yellow "γ", with a 100nm scale bar at lower right. (b) is the SADP from γ-austenite along [110]_{γ+κ}, with reflections labelled 1̄10 (top), 1̄11, 001 and 002 (hkl: austenite; and κ-carbide), the angled indexing reflecting a superlattice. (c) is a BF image of an irregular dark δ-ferrite particle labelled "δ+DO3", 500nm scale bar. (d) is a dark-field (DF) image taken from the (00̄2) superlattice reflection of the ordered phase, showing dense bright nanoscale speckles within the "δ+DO3" particle, 500nm scale bar; the speckles are the ordered precipitates. (e) is the SADP along [110]_{δ+DO3} from δ-ferrite, labelled with 002, 00̄2, 1̄11 and 1̄10 reflections plus faint superlattice spots. Taken together the panels argue that γ-austenite holds only a small κ-carbide fraction (weak superlattice spots in b), whereas DO3 ordered precipitates form in δ-ferrite (c,d,e). No numeric axis values are printed — only scale bars and reflection indices are legible.

observations.observation: Panel (a) shows a dark-field-of-view BF TEM image of a γ-austenite region marked with a yellow 'γ', with a printed 100 nm scale bar.
Panel (b) is a SADP labelled '[110]_{γ+κ}' with diffraction spots indexed 1̄10, 1̄11, 001 and 002.
Panel (c) shows a BF TEM image of an irregular δ-ferrite particle with a yellow 'δ+DO3' label and a printed 500 nm scale bar.
Panel (d) is a dark-field image recorded from the (00̄2) superlattice reflection and shows dense bright nanoscale speckles within the 'δ+DO3' particle, with a 500 nm scale bar.
Panel (e) is a SADP labelled '[110]_{δ+DO3}' whose reflections are indexed 002, 00̄2, 1̄11 and 1̄10, with additional weak superlattice spots.
The caption states the group is TEM micrographs of γ-austenite (a-b) and δ-ferrite (c-e) in the as-cast 6Cr steel strip.
The citing text states the reflection intensity of the superlattice in (b) is barely visible, indicating the volume fraction of κ-carbide is very small.
The citing text gives a measured lattice parameter of 0.389 nm for the κ-carbides and 0.384 nm for γ-austenite in the as-cast 6Cr steel strip (not printed in the panels).
The citing text reports that DO3 phase with size of 28 ± 4 nm precipitates in the δ-ferrite, based on the (00̄2) DF image in (d) and the SADP in (e).
The caption text labels panel (c) as 'BF image of γ-austenite', which conflicts with the yellow 'δ+DO3' label visible in panel (c) and with the caption's own grouping of δ-ferrite as (c-e).
The caption text for panel (b) gives a garbled zone axis ('[011l.'), whereas the panel itself is labelled '[110]_{γ+κ}'.
No numeric axis values, compositions or property numbers are printed in any panel; only scale bars (100 nm, 500 nm) and Miller indices are legible.

subfigures.description: Bright-field TEM micrograph of γ-austenite: a thin, featureless dark band/matrix region with a yellow 'γ' label; 100nm scale bar at lower right. Little internal contrast is resolvable.
Selected-area diffraction pattern from γ-austenite along [110]_{γ+κ}; labelled reflections 1̄10, 1̄11, 001 and 002 (hkl: austenite; hkl: κ-carbide). Superlattice reflections are faint.
Bright-field TEM micrograph of an irregular dark δ-ferrite particle labelled 'δ+DO3'; 500nm scale bar at lower right.
Dark-field image from the (00̄2) superlattice reflection of the ordered phase; dense bright nanoscale speckles (DO3 precipitates) inside the 'δ+DO3' particle on a dark background; 500nm scale bar.
Selected-area diffraction pattern along [110]_{δ+DO3} from δ-ferrite; labelled reflections 002, 00̄2, 1̄11 and 1̄10, with additional faint superlattice spots indicating the ordered DO3 phase.
